info.name: Hayyak API
info.description: Hayyak public API. Every request requires the `X-API-TOKEN` header (collection-level). Sanctum-protected endpoints additionally need a Bearer token from /api/auth/login. Set the `base_url`, `x_api_token`, and `bearer_token` collection variables before running.

request.description: Returns a Sanctum token. Copy it into the `bearer_token` collection variable.
Returns id, city_id, name, and inline neighborhoods. Pass ?city_id= to scope.
Returns tags (admin) and crm_tags (HT-sourced) as separate arrays.
Email auto-populated from the auth user. lead_type / lead_agent are HT-side fields applied at push time.
Removes the favorite and creates a wishlist row for the same unit.
Forwards saved filters to /api/properties or /api/units depending on target.
